notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an adapter-supplied rich FOM transportation type used by an ordinary regional attribute update. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, DDM dimensions, endpoint, callback model, and object/attribute/transportation names. It verifies dimensional handle and metadata lookups, region creation and bounds, regional publication, subscription, named registration, update delivery, source-region metadata, overlap filtering, transportation identity, and the standard value-update request callback without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional object publication, subscription, registration, update, region, and transportation services with FederateAmbassador discovery, value-request, and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional object-management declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
